Q1: Main already does the inventory entries and the after-failure branch update. Only the optional "update the PR head before final CI dispatch" change is left. What should this issue do?
Choices:
A) Record the remaining scope as already delivered by #9627 (inventory) and #9652 (sweep base sync after a final-CI failure), make no code change, and let the issue close. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add the hardening: have `_pr_ensure_final_ci` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:984`) update the branch from main before every dispatch when the head is behind. **Note:** this brings back the extra freshness-update churn and CI re-runs that #9642 removed, and every out-of-date PR gets a new head commit before its final CI.
C) Add a narrower hardening: before dispatch, update the branch only when main changed `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (or other workflow/test-list files) after the PR's merge base, reusing `_pr_base_sync_for_fresh_ci`. Other cases stay with the existing #9652 after-failure sync.
